definition: Publish annotated 1920x1080 HTML to a public URL and call import-design-from-url. Used to build family masters and previews, and for whole decks whose content may be public. 3-4 calls; accepts font substitution.
examples: risk: a silent fallback to a Canva "Code design" that is viewable but not element-editable

definition: Build or repair page content with insert_shape, add_text and insert_fill operations against an existing page. Elements and repairs only.
examples: never for whole decks: default font, black 16px text, roughly 100 calls per deck

definition: merge-designs pulls master pages in order, read-design returns locators inside a transaction, then one edit-design call per page fills text by locator. The default for filled decks because fonts and geometry are inherited from the masters.
examples: roughly 45 calls for a 40-slide deck; merge-designs is capped at 500 operations and 350 pages

prefLabel: Route D - Claude Design Send to Canva
definition: Write a .dc.html deck into a Claude Design project and use Send to Canva. The only path Canva documents as producing an editable presentation from HTML.
examples: probe question 1: whether Canva detection keys on markup or on origin
